We used the DIA-NN 1.81 software to search RAW files, specifically using an in silico spectral library with canonical and isoform protein sequence FASTA files from UNIPROT (UP000005640_9606, February 2021 release), permitting a maximum of one missed cleavage and one variable modification (methionine oxidation), where carbamidomethylation of cysteines was set as a fixed modification.
